body: Root-caused founder-reported newssite staleness (S24-06): http.DefaultClient with no timeout in prwatch/crawler.go's crawlOne let a single hung PR Newswire connection freeze the entire body-fetch crawler for 4+ hours (process alive, ~6min CPU since Jul21, zero log output) while discovery kept finding new releases. Fixed with a 30s per-fetch context timeout. Commit 9fa7358.
title: Fix prwatch-body crawler deadlock causing stale newssite content
